title: Deployment lifecycle: sprint pulse & post-rollout notes — Jun 2027 (sketch)
content:
Overview:
This is a working sketch for the sprint-level deployment window (week of 2027-06-14) and the immediate post-rollout watchlist. Purpose: capture the cadence, owners, preflight and rollback criteria, smoke test matrix, and draft release notes so on-call and feature owners can triage in the first 72 hours.

Sprint pulse calendar (high level):
- Mon 2027-06-14 09:00-10:00 PT — final preflight review (owners present): API, Serving Runtime, DB migrations.
- Tue 2027-06-15 01:00-05:00 PT — small-batch canary (1% global traffic)
- Tue 2027-06-15 05:00-11:00 PT — staged ramp to 10% (regional stagger: us-west -> us-east -> eu)
- Tue 2027-06-15 12:00-18:00 PT — ramp to 50% if signals green
- Wed 2027-06-16 02:00-06:00 PT — full production flip (if green)
- Wed–Fri 2027-06-16 to 2027-06-18 — 72h high-watch period

Preflight checklist (quick):
[ ] All PRs merged and smoke-run green on staging (PR: #984)
[ ] DB migration dry-run completed and rollback validated (ticket: JIRA-DB-2102)
[ ] Canary image baked and SHA pinned in deploy manifest
[ ] Capacity check: dedicated pool estimates + autoscaler sanity (SRE: Diego)
[ ] Throttle policy set for critical endpoints (burst window = 100rps)
[ ] Alerting review: runbook links present in pager alerts and slack playbooks

Canary & ramp steps (operators):
1) Deploy canary subset (1%) to us-west. Tag release: v2027.6.
2) Wait 20m, run smoke suite (see smoke matrix below).
3) If no regressions and errors < 0.5% of baseline and p95 latency delta < 20%, expand to 10% targeted users.
4) Repeat regional ramp with 30m waits between regions.
5) Final production flip only when all three regions report green for 60m.

Smoke test matrix (must be automated; checklist for manual fallback):
- auth/login flow — success rate 99.5% across canary vs control (owner: Priya)
- small chat generation (seq len 64) — correctness + token delta sanity (owner: Aisha)
- kv-cache warmup check — hit-rate > 20% within 10m (owner: Serving team)
- telemetry ingestion (trace/span) — <5% sampling loss (owner: Observability)
- embeddings path (batch 8) — throughput within 85% of baseline (owner: Platform)
- rollback smoke (simulate rollback) — must complete in <15m

Observability signals (primary):
- error budget burn rate (30m)
- p95 latency per region and per model route
- request queue length on GPU workers
- kernel OOM alerts (critical)
- telemetry sampling drop and kinesis rebuffering
- cost spike (token/s billed) anomaly

Rollback triggers (explicit):
- service error rate > 3x baseline for 15m
- p95 latency regresses > 2x baseline and customer impact detected
- any kernel OOM in more than one availability zone
- major data corruption reported (migration)
- automated canary test failures that are deterministic (failing test suite)
If triggered: pause rollout -> notify exec on-call -> roll back canary -> run rollback smoke -> escalate to SRE lead.

Post-rollout tasks (first 72h):
- 0–3h: hold short conference in #release-ops. Confirm all owners confirm green.
- 3–24h: collect sampled sessions for quality eval (research/qa) — save prompts and outputs to bucket release-2027-06 for later eval.
- 24–72h: consolidate telemetry snippets / anomalies into daily digest (owner: Aisha).
- 72h retro: short async retrospective in Confluence and attach sample alerts.

Draft release notes (user-facing draft):
- Improved inference serving for short-chat workloads: up to 25% lower p95 latency for <128 tokens.
- New autoscaling heuristics for Dedicated pools — smoother burst handling and reduced cold-starts.
- Fix: rare kv-cache invalidation that caused elevated latency in cross-region traffic.
- Internal: DB migration to normalize request metadata (no customer-visible schema change).

Known issues (pre-existing or possible):
- Intermittent latency spike in eu-west for seq_len >512 under heavy concurrency (mitigation: throttle batch size; Ongoing tracking: JIRA-EC-412).
- Minor increase in billing delta observed in early canaries due to changed batching defaults — monitoring in place.

Open questions / action items (owners):
- Validate whether new quantization flags cause downstream eval regressions (Aisha) — task: run eval harness on nightly model snapshot.
- Confirm DB migration fallback path timing (Diego) — action: rehearse migration rollback during maintenance window.
- Confirm SLO guardrail thresholds for p95 auto-rollback (Marcus) — propose new threshold by EOD Mon.

Notes to self / quick links:
- Staging smoke run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service-api/actions (workflow: smoke-staging)
- Pager runbook: confluence:runbooks/release-ops
- Slack channel: #release-ops (ping @sre-oncall)
- Postmortem template: confluence:postmortems/template

This doc is intentionally terse and operational-first — expand into a full runbook if we promote this rollout from 'sketch' to 'scheduled'. Keep comments inline below and do not edit the schedule without an explicit +1 from SRE.

-- Marcus
